question: Should OpenClaw add `gateway.reload.autoRestartOnRequired` as a new public config key, or should this PR remove that key and use existing `gateway.reload.mode: "hybrid"` for routine automatic restarts while keeping only the security-critical hot-mode carve-out?
rationale: The PR adds a compatibility-sensitive config surface and changes hot-mode RPC restart behavior, and repository policy requires maintainer intent before accepting duplicate or new config/default surfaces.

options.title: Remove the duplicate opt-in
options.body: Drop `gateway.reload.autoRestartOnRequired`, keep or narrow the security-critical carve-out, and point routine automatic restarts to the existing `hybrid` mode.

options.title: Approve the new key
options.body: Accept `gateway.reload.autoRestartOnRequired` as a deliberate public config surface, then require the docs/help wording and final-head proof fixes before merge.

options.title: Keep current hot/RPC behavior
options.body: Reject the contract change and narrow this work to diagnostics or explicit writer restart intent instead of changing hot-mode restart policy.

recommendation.title: Remove the duplicate opt-in
recommendation.body: Drop `gateway.reload.autoRestartOnRequired`, keep or narrow the security-critical carve-out, and point routine automatic restarts to the existing `hybrid` mode.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent config/gateway documentation and config-surface history make steipete the strongest routing candidate for the public reload contract decision.
